niche: Psychology & human behavior (biases, habits, social dynamics)

ideas.title: Why Rereading Makes You Forget
ideas.angle: It reveals that highlighting and rereading text creates a false sense of familiarity called 'the illusion of competence' rather than actual memory.

hook.en: Stop rereading your notes right now.

ideas.reason: Academic pressure and productivity culture are peaking on social media; videos debunking traditional study habits consistently go viral among students and professionals.

ideas.title: Why Venting Makes You Angrier
ideas.angle: Most people think venting releases anger, but research shows it actually reinforces aggressive neural pathways and makes you feel worse.

hook.en: Venting about your day is failing.

ideas.reason: Mental health awareness is trending, and the counter-intuitive 'catharsis myth' challenges the popular advice of 'letting it all out,' driving high comment engagement.

ideas.title: Why Your Brain Craves Mondays
ideas.angle: The 'Fresh Start Effect' explains why our brains use temporal landmarks to distance ourselves from past failures and boost immediate motivation.
ideas.reason: Self-improvement content performs exceptionally well on Shorts; explaining the biological urge for new beginnings provides an actionable 'aha' moment for viewers.
